subject: gk
question: With a view to boost technical textiles sector in the country, National Technical Textiles Mission (NTTM) was launched for a period from ______ with an outlay of Rs. 1,480 crores.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020-21 to 2023-24**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **National Technical Textiles Mission (NTTM)** was launched by the Government of India to **promote the growth of the technical textiles sector** in the country. 
• The mission was approved for a period from **2020-21 to 2023-24** with a total outlay of **Rs. 1,480 crore**. 
• The mission aims to position India as a **global leader** in technical textiles and increase the domestic market size from **Rs. 40,000 crore to Rs. 2 lakh crore** by 2024-25. 
• It focuses on **research, innovation, and development** in technical textiles, promoting the use of these textiles in various sectors such as agriculture, health, infrastructure, and defense. 
• The mission is divided into four components: **Research, Innovation and Development; Promotion and Market Development; Education and Training; and Export Promotion**. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Technical Textiles:** 
• Technical textiles are **textile materials and products** used for their functional properties rather than aesthetic purposes. 
• Examples include **geotextiles, medical textiles, agro-textiles, and protective textiles**. 
• These materials are essential for sectors such as **construction, agriculture, healthcare, and transportation**. 
• **Objectives of NTTM:** 
• To **develop indigenous machinery** and promote research in technical textiles. 
• To improve the **availability and affordability** of raw materials for technical textiles. 
• To provide **training and skill development** programs to meet the demand for skilled manpower. 
• **Market Growth:** 
• The global market for technical textiles is estimated to grow at a **CAGR of 4%–5%**, providing immense opportunities for India. 
• India’s share in the global technical textiles market is expected to increase with the implementation of the mission. 
• **Government Support:** 
• The mission emphasizes **policy support**, including the development of standards and regulations to boost the domestic industry. 
• Incentives and subsidies are provided to **encourage investment** in technical textiles production and innovation. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Geotextiles:** Used in civil engineering projects like road construction and drainage systems to improve soil stability. 
• **Medical Textiles:** Include products like surgical gowns, bandages, and implants used in healthcare. 
• **Agro-textiles:** Used in agriculture for crop protection, weed control, and soil stabilization. 
• **Protective Textiles:** Provide protection against hazards like fire, chemicals, and extreme temperatures, essential for defense and industrial sectors. 
• The **National Technical Textiles Mission** is a significant step towards making India **self-reliant (Aatmanirbhar)** in the textile sector and boosting exports.
